input: A hook is just a script that Claude Code runs at a fixed point, like before a tool call or when the agent tries to stop. It gets JSON on standard input describing what is about to happen. If it exits with code 0 the action proceeds; with code 2 it is blocked, and whatever the script printed to standard error is shown to the model as feedback. That feedback matters more than people expect, because a clear message usually fixes the behavior on the next try, while a vague one sends the agent in circles.

That feedback matters more than people expect, because a clear message usually fixes the behavior on the next try, while a vague one sends the agent in circles.
